jobs.description:
Job Description: Manual & Automation Tester (Fresher)

\*\*Position:\*\* Manual & Automation Tester

\*\*Experience:\*\* Fresher (0–1 Year)

### Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Manual & Automation Tester to join our QA team. The ideal candidate should have basic knowledge of software testing concepts, test case preparation, bug reporting, and automation testing tools.

### Key Responsibilities

- Perform manual testing of web applications and software.

- Prepare and execute test cases and test scenarios.

- Identify, document, and report bugs or defects.

- Perform functional, regression, and smoke testing.

- Gain hands-on experience with automation testing tools such as Selenium.

- Understand basic programming concepts and automation scripts.

- Collaborate with developers and the QA team to ensure software quality.

- Maintain test documentation and prepare testing reports.

### Required Skills

- Basic understanding of Manual Testing and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).

- Knowledge of SDLC, test cases, test scenarios, and bug life cycle.

- Basic knowledge of Automation Testing using Selenium.

- Familiarity with Java or Python is preferred.

- Basic understanding of SQL and databases is an added advantage.

- Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- Willingness to learn new testing tools and technologies.

### Eligibility Criteria

- B.E./B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc. (Computer Science), or equivalent qualification.
